page.title: Baby growth percentiles
page.subtitle: WHO Child Growth Standards (0-24 months): weight, length, and optional head circumference vs age. Age uses today's date on your device. Educational only—not medical advice.

overview.title: How this works
overview.description: Choose sex, enter birth date and current measurements. Percentiles use WHO-based LMS data (CDC-published tables) compared to your child’s age as of today.

points.who: Based on WHO Child Growth Standards for children under 2 years.
points.range: A wide range of percentiles can be healthy; steady growth over time matters more than any single number.
points.doctor: Regular check-ups with your clinician are essential—this tool does not replace them.

section.title: Measurements
section.description: Birth date must be in the past, and your child must be under 2 years old today (under 730 days since birth).

birthDate.label: Birth date
birthDate.help: Shown in your device’s date format. Age is calculated through today.

length.label: Length / height
length.help: Recumbent length is usual under 2 years; standing height is fine for older infants if that is what you measured.

head.label: Head circumference (optional)
head.help: Centimeters only. Leave blank to skip.

status.empty: Fill the form to calculate percentiles.
status.incomplete: Some fields need attention before calculating.

validation.birth_future: Birth date cannot be after today.
validation.age_two_years: This tool supports ages under 2 years (under 730 days since birth).
validation.weight_range: Weight looks outside the expected range for this chart (about 0.5–25 kg). Check the value.
validation.length_range: Length looks outside the expected range for this chart (about 30–110 cm). Check the value.
validation.head_invalid: Enter a valid head circumference or leave blank.
validation.head_range: Head circumference looks outside the usual range (about 25–55 cm). Check the value.

section.title: Percentiles
section.description: Percentiles compare your child with others of the same age and sex in the reference population.
section.empty: Results appear here after you calculate.

percentile.unknown: Could not compute a percentile for this value.
percentile.typical: Within a common range for age.
percentile.lt_3: Below the 3rd percentile for this reference—discuss persistent low percentiles with your clinician.
percentile.gt_99: Above the 99th percentile for this reference—discuss with your clinician if measurements stay very high or low.
percentile.lt_half: Below the 1st percentile on this scale—verify the measurement and talk to your clinician if concerned.

chart.title: Compared to WHO reference (same age)
chart.description: Shaded band spans about the 3rd to 97th percentile at this age; vertical line is the median. Dot is your child’s measurement.
chart.legend_note: Band limits use the LMS inverse at fixed z-scores (~3rd and ~97th); exact cutoffs can differ slightly from published tables.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.body: LMS parameters are from the CDC distribution of WHO Child Growth Standards (birth–24 months), the same family of curves used for WHO weight-for-age, length-for-age, and head circumference-for-age charts.

method.title: Method
method.body: Age is whole calendar days from birth through today on your device. Months for the curves use days ÷ 30.4375. LMS rows are linearly interpolated between completed months.

footer.disclaimer: Educational tool only. Not for diagnosis or treatment. Consult a qualified health professional about your child’s growth.
